template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

cut_contour.note: Board outline with the 25 mm corners of handbook 4.7 and 4.8. As a sticker the same line is the kiss cut.

production.format: 400 x 600 mm, as handbook 4.7 and 4.8 (rijstvlies bord)
production.material: Rijstvlies board 8 mm (wall or column) or 16 mm (pole), full colour foil plus laminate (handbook 4.7). Alternative: the same file as a column sticker (wall foil plus laminate) to cover the existing plates.
production.colour: Solid PY-Blauw CMYK 100/83/0/17 (no verloop, at Rick's request), white bubble and caption

notes: New design for the walking route to the exit, in the 400 x 600 column format of handbook 4.7 and 4.8, with a solid PY-Blauw face instead of the verloop (requested): white bubble (py-atom-shape-bubble-solid at the bubble position of py-comp-bord-picto-bubble-face), navy walking figure and navy route arrow, caption in two lines at the caption position and size of 4.7. The figure always walks towards the arrow (mirrored for links). Wayfinding only: it does not replace the green escape route signs (NEN-EN-ISO 7010, NEN 6088).
